query: A'sTool トライアングル 絵本

items.title: Peter's Chair
items.description: When Peter discovers his blue furniture is being painted pink for a new baby sister, he rescues the last unpainted item, a chair, and runs away.

items.title: The Triangle Stair
items.description: A puppy comes home from school and it is raining too hard for him to go out and play, or even for his friends to come over. He wonders what he can do, and suddenly his imagination comes to the rescue. A triangular stair in his house is magically transformed into a pier, a campsite, a tree house, a rocket ship, and finally a theater. The whimsical drawings and humor in this book appeal to adults as well as children.
